name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
description: A voluntary pension scheme for eligible Indian citizens, administered by PFRDA.

documents.title: Frequently Asked Questions - Atal Pension Yojana

eligibility_rules.label: Minimum joining age is 18
Maximum joining age is 40 (inclusive)
Applicant is an Indian citizen
Applicant has a savings bank or post office savings bank account
Applicant is not or has not been an income-tax payer on the application date

required_documents: Savings bank or post office savings bank account details
documents_note: PFRDA describes a savings account as mandatory and nominee details as mandatory. Aadhaar is described as desirable for identification, with details to be submitted later if not provided at enrolment; it is not listed here as a mandatory document.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
applicability: India-wide; application is made through an LPG distributor or the official online process
description: Provides eligible adult women from poor households with a deposit-free LPG connection, subject to scheme conditions.

eligibility_rules.label: Applicant is at least 18 years old
Applicant is a woman
Poor-household deprivation declaration is satisfied
No LPG connection is registered to a household member listed in the family composition document

required_documents: Completed KYC/application form and recent photograph
Aadhaar of adult family members in the family-composition document
Ration card or other accepted family-composition document
documents_note: The official FAQ lists additional alternatives and migrant-applicant documents; consult the source for the current applicable list.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education
applicability: India-wide with State/UT-specific quotas and selection tests
description: A scholarship programme for selected students continuing from Class VIII into Class IX in eligible government, government-aided, or local-body schools.

documents.title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme Revised Guidelines

eligibility_rules.label: Annual parental income from all sources is no more than ₹350,000
Applicant is a student
Applicant is in the Class VIII selection stage
Applicant attends a government, government-aided, or local-body school
Applicant meets the applicable State/UT selection-test requirement
Applicant meets the Class VII marks requirement, including any applicable relaxation

documents_note: The checked scheme guidelines describe State/UT selection and school conditions but do not establish a single uniform applicant document checklist. Check the relevant State/UT selection notice. The selection-test and Class VII marks rules are included but remain UNKNOWN because this form does not collect those results.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
applicability: India-wide; State/UT governments identify eligible farmer families using land records
description: Income support for eligible landholding farmer families with cultivable land, subject to exclusions in the scheme guidelines.

eligibility_rules.label: Farmer family owns cultivable land as recorded by the relevant State/UT
Landholding meets the scheme's applicable land-record date and succession requirements
No listed PM-KISAN exclusion applies to the farmer family

required_documents: Applicant/family identification information as required by the State/UT process
Landholding details verified through the applicable State/UT land records
documents_note: The operational guidelines and FAQ describe State/UT land-record identification and required beneficiary details. This is not a definitive list of documents an individual must upload or present; confirm with the official portal and State/UT process.

name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi)
department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
applicability: India-wide for students admitted to eligible Quality Higher Educational Institutions (QHEIs) in India
description: Provides a collateral-free, guarantor-free education-loan product for students with merit-based admission to eligible QHEIs in India.

eligibility_rules.label: Applicant is admitted to an eligible QHEI in India
Admission is through merit or an open competitive examination, not management quota
Applicant is enrolled in a degree or diploma programme

documents_note: The checked scheme guidelines explain the loan and interest-subvention conditions but do not provide a complete universal applicant document checklist. Follow the PM-Vidyalaxmi portal and participating lender's current application instructions. Income-based interest subvention is a separate benefit and is not calculated by this initial engine.
